# PHP library (mongodb/mongodb) versus the mongodb PECL extension

# PHP library (mongodb/mongodb) versus the mongodb PECL extension — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for PHP library (mongodb/mongodb) versus the mongodb PECL extension. Run status: COMPLETED.

## Definitions

- [statement] The Composer package mongodb/mongodb is a high-level PHP library layered over the mongodb extension. It provides client, database, and collection abstractions plus CRUD and common-command helpers. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-php-library · keywords: PHP library (mongodb/mongodb) versus the mongodb PECL extension · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-php-driver, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/

## Structure and components

- [statement] The upgrade guide states that library and extension patch versions are not synchronized and provides separate update commands for each component. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/references/upgrade.md

## How it works

- [statement] When Composer reports that the mongodb extension is missing despite it appearing in another PHP environment, check which PHP binary Composer uses and which configuration the CLI and web runtime load. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-php-driver/issues/874 · keywords: PHP library (mongodb/mongodb) versus the mongodb PECL extension · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/get-started.md
- [statement] When an installed extension is unavailable at runtime, check the PHP runtime and its configuration: multiple PHP versions have separate extension-install commands, and CLI and web environments can load different php.ini files. (high confidence) — https://www.php.net/manual/en/mongodb.installation.php · keywords: PHP library (mongodb/mongodb) versus the mongodb PECL extension · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/get-started.md

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Install the library with composer require mongodb/mongodb and separately install and enable the mongodb extension; the library requires that extension. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-php-library · keywords: PHP library (mongodb/mongodb) versus the mongodb PECL extension · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/get-started.md

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Composer platform requirements describe the PHP environment and its extensions as virtual packages. Requiring a platform package installs no code; it cannot substitute for installing the native mongodb extension required by the PHP library. (high confidence) — https://getcomposer.org/doc/articles/composer-platform-dependencies.md · keywords: PHP library (mongodb/mongodb) versus the mongodb PECL extension · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-php-library

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The extension supplies the low-level connection management, BSON encoding/decoding, command/query/write execution, and cursor functionality. It connects PHP to libmongoc, libbson, and libmongocrypt. (high confidence) — https://www.php.net/manual/en/mongodb.overview.php · keywords: PHP library (mongodb/mongodb) versus the mongodb PECL extension · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-php-driver
- [statement] The extension can be used directly without the PHP library. The PHP manual and library maintainers recommend the library or another high-level abstraction for most application development. (high confidence) — https://www.php.net/manual/en/mongodb.overview.php · keywords: PHP library (mongodb/mongodb) versus the mongodb PECL extension · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-php-library, https://stackoverflow.com/questions/55197782/difference-between-mongodb-pecl-driver-and-composer-phplib
- [statement] The legacy mongo extension has a different API from the newer mongodb extension and PHP library; migrating existing legacy applications requires API adaptation. (high confidence) — https://derickrethans.nl/new-drivers-part2.html · keywords: PHP library (mongodb/mongodb) versus the mongodb PECL extension · also: https://github.com/alcaeus/mongo-php-adapter
- [statement] A September 2026 Herd issue reports a library upgrade blocked by the bundled extension: the reporter says mongodb/mongodb 2.4.1 requires ext-mongodb ^2.4 while Herd supplies 2.3.3. This is a report about that environment, not a universal package compatibility statement. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-09) — https://github.com/beyondcode/herd-community/issues/1749
- [statement] After installing the library, load Composer's vendor/autoload.php in the application so Composer-installed classes are available. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/get-started.md · keywords: PHP library (mongodb/mongodb) versus the mongodb PECL extension · also: https://getcomposer.org/doc/articles/composer-platform-dependencies.md
